# Twelfth pass (generated by scripts/make_stats_p19.py; pre-registered in LOG.md)

Novel-view test: Gaussian splatting started from the predicted points of the input views, unfiltered (all) or without 20% of them (random; lowest native confidence; lowest support score; lowest mean rank of both), identical optimisation, eight held-out rig views. 15 DTU scans, seed 0. Differences are means over scans with a paired sign-flip p; LPIPS lower is better.
